### Understanding God's Discipline
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/understanding-gods-discipline
Passage: Job 5:17-27
Points:
- Biblical wisdom requires understanding truth as well as applying it appropriately to specific situations.
- Eliphaz accurately observes that divine reproof and discipline can be a sign of God's love.
- His counsel fails because he assumes all human suffering is punitive chastisement for particular sins.
- Scripture demonstrates that God also uses nonpunitive trials to build perseverance and teach His sufficiency.
- Misapplying biblical truths about suffering causes harm and burdens people with false guilt.
